description:
Older name for buy_listing, kept so existing agents keep working. Starts a
    Hokai listing and returns a payment link (checkout_url, also given as
    payment_url). Nothing is charged by this call. Refunds are not automatic:
    ask damien@hokai.io.

    Args:
        tool_url: the product's own website, e.g. https://example.com
        email: a work email for the vendor
        company: company name (optional)
        note: anything the editors should know (optional)
name: submit_listing
